description: `{ className: condition }` applies each class whose value is truthy. Merges with the static `class` attribute.
`[a, b, { c: cond }]` applies every truthy entry; objects inside arrays work as in the object syntax.
Object of CSS properties (camelCase or quoted kebab-case) or an array of such objects. Vue adds vendor prefixes when needed.
`:style="{ '--accent': color }"` sets a CSS variable that stylesheet rules can read.
